notes:
- Linux (x86_64) build alongside Windows: ZombiesConcept_v<version>_linux.zip contains a single
  executable (ZombiesConcept_v<version>.x86_64). Uses Vulkan and falls back to OpenGL automatically.
- Self-updating: when the main menu finds a newer version, the game downloads it, verifies its SHA-256
  checksum, unpacks the new executable next to the current one, restarts into it, and the new version
  deletes the old file. The update button shows the download progress. It can be turned off in Settings
  (Auto-update); then the update panel offers "Update & Restart" or a manual download.
  This works from v0.07 onwards (older versions can only open the download link).
- Check for Updates downloads the build for your platform: Linux on Linux, Windows on Windows.
- Releases on github.com/izuwyn/Zombies now include both the Windows and Linux zips.
